text: Mila and Tala were cousins and they were both eleven. Mila had short hair and Tala always wore a red hair tie. One rainy afternoon they were bored in Lola's kitchen and Tala found an old bamboo fan behind the rice bin. It was plain and brown and a little dusty. They ran out to the yard to shake the dust off it but the rain was still falling so they came back inside. Lola said the fan belonged to her mother and nobody had used it in years. Mila got the paints from the cabinet and they painted white sampaguita flowers all over the fan, one flower each, taking turns. Tala got paint on her red hair tie and Mila laughed at her. When it dried they fanned Lola with it at the kitchen table. Lola said it was prettier now than when it was new.
